# => help output
exec govulnfilter -h
! stdout .
cmp stderr usage.text

# => missing command (this comes from marco-m/clim actually)
! exec govulnfilter
! stdout .
stderr 'expected a command'

# => version
# ONLY testing that it exits 0 and prints anything to stderr :-/
exec govulnfilter version
! stdout .
stderr .

-- usage.text --
govulnfilter -- ignore temporarily a govulncheck vulnerability

Usage: govulnfilter <command> [options]

Examples:

 $ govulnfilter init
 Create the .govulnfilter.json configuration file.
 Then, edit it accordingly.

 $ govulnfilter run ./...
 Invoke govulncheck to scan the current module. Normally this is all you need.

Commands:

 init        Create the .govulnfilter.json configuration file
 version     Print the govulnfilter version

Options:

 -h, --help    Print this help and exit
